$sid..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('public/hostUid').val() === auth.uid) || data.child('public/hostUid').val() === auth.uid)

controller..write: auth != null && !data.exists() && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('token').val() === root.child('sessions/' + $sid + '/secret/token').val() && root.child('sessions/' + $sid + '/public/status').val() === 'open'
controller..validate: newData.hasChildren(['uid', 'nickname', 'token', 'joinedAt']) && newData.child('nickname').isString() && newData.child('nickname').val().length >= 2 && newData.child('nickname').val().length <= 16 && newData.child('joinedAt').isNumber() && (!newData.child('idToken').exists() || (newData.child('idToken').isString() && newData.child('idToken').val().length <= 4096))

$shotId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['sessionId', 'shotId', 'directionX', 'directionY', 'power', 'clientTimestamp']) && newData.child('shotId').val() === $shotId && newData.child('sessionId').val() === $sid && newData.child('directionX').isNumber() && newData.child('directionY').isNumber() && newData.child('power').isNumber() && newData.child('clientTimestamp').isNumber()
